Definition: Shirjon or Sirjon, a peak of the Lebanon
BiblicalUsage: Sirion is the name the Sidonians give Mount Hermon. It is the peak the psalmist watches skip like a young unicorn at the voice of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: Two names for one mountain tells me everyone wanted Hermon, and Sirion is its other name. I hold that the peaks skip at God's voice, and that is the power I trust.
